pages.title: A call to reception
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good evening. How can I help?
lines.audioText: Good evening. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m in room 204. The shower doesn’t work
lines.audioText: I’m in room 204. The shower doesn’t work.
lines.translation: Estou no quarto 204. O chuveiro não funciona

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m sorry. Do you need a towel?
lines.audioText: I’m sorry. Do you need a towel?
lines.translation: Sinto muito. Você precisa de uma toalha?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, please. Can I have two towels?
lines.audioText: Yes, please. Can I have two towels?
lines.translation: Sim, por favor. Posso pedir duas toalhas?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Of course. Someone can come at six. Is that OK?
lines.audioText: Of course. Someone can come at six. Is that OK?
lines.translation: Claro. Alguém pode ir às seis. Tudo bem?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I’ll be here
lines.audioText: Yes, thank you. I’ll be here.

pages.title: Ask for help politely
pages.instruction: Connect the meaning, the form and the example

rows.subject: Ask for an item
rows.example: Can I have two towels, please?

pages.title: Can you help me?
pages.instruction: Tell reception the problem and ask for help

pages.title: Reception has an update
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hello, Ana. This is reception. Someone can come to your room at seven this evening, not six. We have two towels for you here. You can collect them now, or we can bring them at seven. Please tell us what you need. Thank you!
pages.audioText: Hello, Ana. This is reception. Someone can come to your room at seven this evening, not six. We have two towels for you here. You can collect them now, or we can bring them at seven. Please tell us what you need. Thank you!
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!

items.cue: Repeat the time offered by reception
items.answer: Someone can come at seven this evening
